items.caption: This modern seal-script-style rendering shows 大, the graph from which 太 is analyzed as a differentiated form. The added distinguishing mark of 太 is not shown.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style rendering of 大 centered on a white square.
items.selection_reason: It provides a visual comparison for the proposed graphic relationship between 太 and 大, while making clear that it is not an ancient 太 form.

limitations.text: The selected image shows only 大. No image with verified identity and dating is available here to illustrate the dotted 太 form; the earliest distinguishable 太 examples are reported as Western Han inscriptions, while proposed earlier forms remain disputed.
